_source: ChatGPT draft 2026-11-11 (chatgpt.com, Claude in Chrome). Placeholders {Mountain} {town}.
desc: Will {Mountain} glow at sunset tonight? Check the summit glow forecast, sunset time, clear windows over the next five days, and nearby viewpoints.
intro: Alpenglow happens when low-angle sunlight lights up a mountain summit after the valley below has gone dark. It needs a clear summit and clear sky toward the setting sun.
glowGreat: Great light is expected on {Mountain} at sunset tonight, with skies forecast to favor a visible glow.
glowDecent: Some sunset color is possible on {Mountain} tonight, but clouds may limit the glow.
glowPoor: Cloud cover is expected to limit sunset light on {Mountain} tonight.
windowsNone: No clear summit windows are forecast for {Mountain} in the next five days.
spotsIntro: These viewpoints offer views of {Mountain}, with distances measured from {town}.
forecastNote: This is a weather-based forecast, and a visible summit glow is never certain.
ctaText: Get the Mountain Visibility Forecast app for $1.99 to check summit visibility hour by hour.

faq.q: What causes {Mountain} to glow pink at sunset?
faq.a: Low-angle sunlight travels through more atmosphere, scattering shorter wavelengths and leaving more red and orange light to reach the summit.

faq.q: Can {Mountain} glow when it is cloudy?
faq.a: Yes, if the summit and the sky toward the setting sun remain clear enough for sunlight to reach the mountain.

faq.q: Does a Great glow forecast guarantee sunset color?
faq.a: No. Cloud conditions can change before sunset, and even a clear summit does not guarantee visible alpenglow.
